summary: Verified exact hashes of all five application files from both writing workers. Determined that the 8 conflict records represent GENUINE content differences (not duplicate metadata, not an aggregation defect).

conflict_record_analysis.explanation: 8 conflict records = 4 conflicting paths × 2 workers (one record per (workerId, path) tuple). The 4 non-conflicting records are: package.json from software-engineer-1 (identical content → no conflict), package.json from documentation-writer-2 (identical → no conflict), plus 2 .npm/* cache files from software-engineer-1 that documentation-writer-2 didn't write (no other version to conflict with).
conflict_record_analysis.g7_19a_conflict_detection_correctness: PASS — G7-19A's conflict detection correctly identified the 4 genuinely-different paths and excluded the 1 identical path (package.json).

g7_19e_report_corrections.note: The G7-19E report's Note 6 incorrectly stated that 'Both workers wrote identical content (verified by matching contentHash for each path)'. The actual evidence shows ONLY package.json is identical; the other 4 files have genuinely different content. This correction does NOT change the G7-19E outcome (the smoke test still PARTIAL: the worker's npm test script has defects; the system truthfully reported the mission status).
g7_19e_report_corrections.impact_on_g7_19e_findings: NONE — the G7-19E integrity gates A–G evaluation is unchanged. Gate B (package coherence) still passes: the selected worker (software-engineer-1) is a single coherent worker; its packageIdentity (4a3db1a3...c452892c) is computed over all its files (including .npm/* cache). The two workers' packageIdentities are DIFFERENT (software-engineer-1: fe4673bbf929c7f6909d935d76aa4934a3d2ba1a384984a87c4cb7fdf72f37f2 over the 5 manifest files only; documentation-writer-2: 7e6109bd39fa99127c1c7f9a081a7c08a7677d05e75274ffb87355e7717c3277 over the 5 manifest files only) — but software-engineer-1's packageIdentity when including .npm/* cache files becomes 4a3db1a3...c452892c, which is lexicographically smaller than documentation-writer-2's 7e6109bd..., so software-engineer-1 wins the tiebreak.
g7_19e_report_corrections.new_finding_for_g7_19f: The packageIdentity computation includes .npm/* cache files (which have a TIMESTAMP in the filename: .npm/_logs/2026-10-11T05_22_44_449Z-debug-0.log). This makes the packageIdentity non-reproducible across runs. See G7-19F report Section 7 (Remaining Limitations) for details.
